title: Fix disallowed origin CORS errors in the canvas editor

requirements.summary: Add 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' to allowed origins in the canvas editor (EditorPage.tsx) and any iframe/postMessage communication logic to eliminate 'disallowed origin' errors.
acceptanceCriteria: No 'draft-editor:error disallowed origin' messages appear in the browser console when the editor page is loaded at https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz.
The canvas customization editor loads and functions correctly (image upload, drag, zoom, rotation) without being blocked by origin checks.
postMessage communication between the editor and any parent frame (or vice versa) succeeds without origin errors.
The fix applies to all pages/components that trigger the disallowed origin error, not just a single file.

file_operations.description: Update any hardcoded origin whitelist arrays, window.addEventListener('message', ...) handlers with origin checks, or postMessage calls to explicitly include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' as a permitted origin. Remove any origin filters that would block the Caffeine preview domain. Ensure all postMessage communication allows this origin.

requirements.summary: Audit and update all frontend files for hardcoded origin whitelists, message event listeners with origin checks, and Content-Security-Policy meta tags to include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' as a permitted origin.
acceptanceCriteria: All origin whitelist arrays in the frontend include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz'.
No Content-Security-Policy meta tag in index.html blocks scripts, frames, or connect-src from the Caffeine preview domain.
Any message event listeners that reject unknown origins are updated to permit the Caffeine preview domain.
The application runs without CORS or origin-related console errors on the preview deployment.

file_operations.description: Review and update any Content-Security-Policy meta tags or other security headers that might restrict frame-src, script-src, or connect-src directives. Ensure 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' is not blocked by CSP rules.

Search for any window.addEventListener('message', ...) handlers, origin whitelist arrays, or postMessage calls in the router configuration or global event listeners. Update all such locations to include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' as a permitted origin.
Check for any message event listeners or origin-checking logic in the main layout component. Update to permit 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' if any origin restrictions are present.
Audit for any postMessage or iframe communication that might navigate to or embed the editor. Update origin checks to allow 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz'.
Review for any message event handlers or origin validation logic. Ensure 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' is permitted if any origin checks exist.

Check for canvas-based production file generation or any iframe/postMessage logic that might interact with editor previews. Update origin whitelists to include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz'.
